title: Registered projects with no GitHub origin remote
method: for each of the 81 projects in projects.json, run `git -C <path> remote get-url origin`; a non-zero exit means no origin is configured. Then probe GitHub for a repository of the same name under the lileililiwen account.

findings.remedy: add the origin remote pointing at the existing public repository; no creation needed
add the origin remote pointing at the existing public repository; no creation needed

create the repository and add the origin remote. It already carries discoverability metadata, so `scripts/github_metadata.py <path> --publish` would apply description and topics once the remote exists.
findings.note: This is the cause of the HTTP 404 seen when publishing metadata, not a metadata defect. The discoverability block is present and valid.

findings.remedy: create the repository and add the origin remote, same as platform-contracts.
findings.note: Its README records that registry publication of the crates is BLOCKED on owner approval, tracked in docs/publication.md. Creating the GitHub repository is a separate decision from publishing the crates.
directory name careBridge differs from registered id care-bridge; a publication step must pass --repository explicitly
directory name trailCrew differs from registered id trail-crew; a publication step must pass --repository explicitly

why_it_matters: workspace-governance/scripts/github_metadata.py resolves the target repository from `git remote get-url origin`. With no origin, it fails with GITHUB_REMOTE_MISSING and refuses to publish, even when the local discoverability block is valid.
A repository with no remote cannot be backed up, cannot receive a release, and cannot be recovered from GitHub if the working copy is lost.
For the 8 never-published projects, discoverability metadata exists locally but can never reach GitHub, so they are effectively invisible to search.
not_done: No remote was added and no repository was created. Creating a GitHub repository and pushing are publish actions the owner performs.
The public/private intent for the 8 unpublished projects is undecided; do not assume public.
